Message:
“Fulfill thy duty”...
I still don’t have the first clue
how to follow the
Great Dragon God’s will...

Is there even
a duty out there that
someone like me can fulfill...?

Huh...? What’s goin’ on...?
Everyone’s in a big rush...

“Fenrir an’ Cerberus
got captured by the Inquisition

“‘Let’s go save them together’...?
Th-There’s no way
I can do that...!”

“Even if I went,
I wouldn’t be o’ any help...!

“You can’t know for sure
until you try”...
That’s what Miss Cu Sith said,
but all I could do was
hang my head in shame...

“Sorry for asking the
impossible of you.”
Seein’ how much I was tremblin’,
Miss Cu Sith said those words
before leavin’ the room...
